Retrieval quality against the relevance labels, versus the simulated p50 latency of the same queries through the WebAssembly SQLite build over HTTP range requests. Each point is one configuration; hover for rounds and bytes. Colour gives the family (FTS5, dense, late interaction), squares mark the dense IVF layout. Numbers and method: README.md.
